title: Australian Poached Rhubarb
description: A sweet and tangy dessert that showcases the unique flavor of rhubarb, perfect for a weeknight treat. This recipe is a simple yet elegant way to enjoy the fresh flavors of the season.
instructions: Combine the rhubarb, sugar, water, and lemon juice in a saucepan.
Bring to a boil over medium heat, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-12 minutes.
Use a slotted spoon to transfer the poached rhubarb to a serving dish.
Serve warm or chilled, garnished with a sprinkle of sugar if desired.
